Drop real recordings here (mp3, wav or ogg) to replace the synthesised sounds:
  horn.mp3     Loco air horn. Hold H to sound it; files longer than 1.2 s loop their middle
               section while H is held, so a 2-4 s clean dual-tone blast works best.
  engine.mp3   Seamless loop of traction motor / diesel engine (pitch follows notch & speed).
  clatter.mp3  Seamless loop of wheel/rail clatter (rate follows speed).
  chime.mp3    Station announcement jingle (played when arriving at a halt).
  rain.mp3     Seamless loop of rain (used in Monsoon weather; muffled automatically in the cab).

Without these files the simulator synthesises a dual-tone reed air horn, traction whine
(electric) or engine rumble (diesel), rail-joint clatter, brake hiss and a station chime,
followed by a spoken announcement (browser speech, en-IN voice when available), and a
monsoon soundscape: rain bed, droplet patter on the body/roof, cab wipers, and thunder
with a matching lightning flash.
Free sources: Freesound.org, Mixkit, Pixabay sound effects (check each licence).
